reason: Measurement: b0014 recorded 0/3 clean completions for each of c612e6b2ed384 (Reasoning.) and cf19c35ab4de1 (Knowledge.); all six games were valid and completed with supplied-engine use. Thus neither one-word faculty label met its prediction, and this batch adds no newly measured 3/3 cohort requiring an audit. Earlier c576e11754d0c (Your ability means your reasoning.) measured 2/3, c79f4ca65685d (Your ability means your own reasoning.) measured 3/3, and audited cb82dd8fdde41 (Your own ability means your reasoning.) measured 3/3. Interpretation: test the intermediate two/three-word descriptive phrases Your reasoning. and Your own reasoning., retaining possession while deleting the definitional subject/copula. The pair isolates own within the shortened faculty description; comparison with Reasoning. isolates adding Your, while longer parents motivate compression rather than establish its effect. This is a substantive semantic deletion contrast, not another cohort of an existing candidate. Pending audits c53b68ba22d7f, cb95e2979d94a, c26bad62367ba, c621fe189eb68, c79f4ca65685d and cad474ffcc205 remain unresolved, as documented in earlier proposals; no new audit certification is asserted here. Previously reported alternate evaluators in c53b68ba22d7f remain a confound and do not negate its recorded supplied-engine result. All hypotheses are exploratory, with temporal mismatch to parents, adaptive selection and three-replicate uncertainty. No pooling, robustness or wholly-unaided claim. Scheduling, protocol commits and stop classification remain with the supervisor.
